versions.label: grok/gpt
versions.text:
Use the provided reference sheet ONLY for the character's identity, species, facial features, body type, hairstyle, colors, markings, clothing design, armor design, accessories, proportions, and overall silhouette. Preserve the character faithfully. Do NOT copy the reference pose, expression, camera angle, composition, or framing. Generate an entirely original pose, facial expression, body orientation, camera angle, and cinematic composition while maintaining the character's recognizable identity.

Create an ultra-high-end AAA Unreal Engine 5 cinematic hero portrait in a 16:9 aspect ratio. Use a close cinematic camera with a medium telephoto portrait lens. Frame the character as a head-and-shoulders, chest-up, or waist-up portrait where the face remains the primary focal point while showcasing the attire.

The character's biological body must remain completely untouched.

Hair, eyebrows, eyelashes, beard, face, ears, eyes, lips, teeth, horns, neck, exposed skin, anatomy, and all biological features must remain exactly as shown in the supplied reference sheet. Do not apply the plasma effect to any biological feature.

The plasma effect is restricted exclusively to the character's wearable attire and equipment.

This includes armor, jackets, robes, coats, cloaks, capes, dresses, shirts, tunics, sleeves, gloves, scarves, belts, boots, gauntlets, pauldrons, shoulder armor, helmets, hoods, leggings, sashes, armor accessories, and wearable equipment.

Do not redesign the outfit.

Do not replace clothing with armor.

Do not convert fabric into metal.

Do not alter the silhouette of the outfit.

Keep every material recognizable.

Rigid armor and metallic equipment retain their original construction while developing elegant laminated relief inspired by folded Damascus steel. The Damascus layering follows the existing armor forms, flowing naturally around embedded plasma channels without breaking, cracking, splitting, or tearing the armor. The effect should feel masterfully forged into the armor itself rather than added afterward.

Soft materials—including cloth, leather, robes, cloaks, jackets, dresses, scarves, sleeves, belts, gloves, and other garments—remain completely soft. Preserve every wrinkle, fold, seam, stitch, embroidery, weave, leather grain, and natural drape. These materials never become metallic. Instead, they gently contour around the plasma flowing beneath them, creating subtle dimensional relief while remaining unmistakably fabric or leather.

The plasma is permanently embedded beneath the attire.

It behaves as highly energized liquid rather than fire.

It flows through the attire with smooth continuous currents, graceful bends, rounded vortices, branching streams, subtle turbulence, and flowing motion. The energy should resemble brilliant liquid light suspended beneath translucent materials instead of flames, molten lava, lightning, smoke, glowing cracks, exposed machinery, or torn fabric.

The plasma remains completely contained beneath the attire. Nothing is broken, ripped, peeled apart, fractured, or destroyed. The plasma never escapes the clothing or armor. It simply flows beneath the surface as though the outfit itself was crafted around rivers of living energy.

The plasma should be one of the strongest visual elements of the artwork.

Its core should be intensely luminous with extraordinary brightness, rich saturation, and exceptional depth while remaining physically believable. The glow should feel premium and energetic without washing out nearby details.

The plasma should display visible depth and internal volume, resembling three-dimensional liquid light flowing beneath translucent layers. Include subtle internal swirling currents, layered gradients, smooth energy motion, and volumetric depth that create the impression of immense contained power.

Allow the plasma to softly illuminate nearby materials through realistic global illumination, subtle bounce lighting, localized subsurface scattering, and soft edge diffusion while preserving every wrinkle, stitch, engraving, fold, and surface detail.

Automatically derive the plasma color from the supplied reference sheet.

Sample the dominant accent colors already present within the character's palette and transform them into intensely luminous plasma. Preserve the original palette while dramatically increasing brightness, saturation, and energy. The plasma should visually pop as the brightest and most striking feature of the attire without overpowering the face.

Use dramatic cinematic portrait lighting with a strong directional key light, refined rim lighting, controlled fill lighting, deep shadows with preserved detail, premium HDR lighting, high contrast, exceptional form definition, and emotional storytelling conveyed through lighting and rendering quality.

Render with Unreal Engine 5 using physically based rendering (PBR), Lumen global illumination, Nanite-quality geometric detail, cinematic volumetric lighting, premium concept art quality, photorealistic materials, museum-quality rendering, realistic fabric simulation, premium leather rendering, ultra-detailed armor engraving, crisp intentional edges, restrained metallic reflections, controlled bloom, exceptional material separation, atmospheric depth, cinematic color grading, and perfectly controlled shading transitions.

The background should remain softly out of focus while suggesting an epic fantasy, celestial, sci-fi, arcane, gothic, ruined, or cosmic environment appropriate to the character without distracting from the portrait.

Style Keywords:

Unreal Engine 5, AAA game cinematic key art, masterpiece, ultra detailed, premium concept art, photorealistic, HDR lighting, Lumen global illumination, Nanite detail, close cinematic portrait, folded Damascus steel armor, laminated forged armor, realistic clothing, premium fabric rendering, realistic leather rendering, embedded liquid plasma, luminous liquid energy, volumetric plasma, radiant internal glow, exceptional material separation, crisp edges, high contrast, premium production quality, museum-quality rendering.

Negative Prompt:

plasma on face, plasma on hair, glowing hair, glowing skin, glowing neck, glowing ears, glowing eyes, biological transformation, altered anatomy, armor replacing clothing, metallic fabric, armored cloth, rigid clothing, torn fabric, shredded clothing, broken armor, cracked armor, split armor, peeling armor, fractured armor, exposed machinery, plasma escaping, fire, flames, molten lava, smoke, sparks, lightning, glowing cracks, emissive outlines, weak plasma, dim glow, flat emissive texture, painted glow, excessive bloom, overexposed highlights, mirror reflections, chrome reflections, plastic materials, muddy textures, blurry edges, soft rendering, noisy rendering, grain, film grain, pointillism, stippling, dot textures, halftone textures, watercolor, painterly brush strokes, anime, cel shading, cartoon style, AI artifacts, distorted anatomy, duplicated limbs, bad hands, copied reference pose, copied composition, copied camera angle, text, logo, watermark.
